blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left–right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.
blocks.zh: 早产婴儿的自发运动分析越来越依赖无标记姿势估计(PE)直接从录像中得出临床相关的运动生物标记. 训练精准的婴儿PE模型需要一大批手动附加说明的键点,而人的注释本身容易出错. 噪音的关键点(即其真实解剖位置位置被错位的关键点)在这种临床环境中尤其有问题,因为它们可以作为人工文物被传播到重建后的联合轨道上. 根据在噪声标签学习文献中确立的小损失假说和基于训练动力学的样本选择,我们提出了一个用于检测噪声关键点说明的新框架。 对混合进取模式进行了培训,从空间坐标和当地视觉特征中预测出每个关键点的解剖类别;然后利用由此产生的交叉进取训练动态来得出每个关键点的描述符,这些描述符通过不受监督的集群被分割成干净而吵闹的子集. 我们验证了NeoPose(新收集的65名住院早产婴儿的数据集)的方法,这是在两种现实的噪声情景下(随机位置扰动和左-右相换),跨越了多声层。 结果表明,拟议办法在高音键检测中达到高达91.9%的F1分分数。 该框架进一步概括到各种COCO基准中,从培训集中过滤出CE探测到的吵闹关键点,也可在下游产生可衡量的改进(最高为7.4个AP点),在中高噪音水平上形成估计准确性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spontaneous, endogenously-generated movement patterns exhibited by preterm infants (i.e., newborns born before 37 weeks of gestation) during post-birth hospitalization are highly reliable markers for the early assessment of neurodevelopmental trajectories [ 8 , 11 ] . During the first months of life, infants display a rich repertoire of spontaneous movements that reflect the integrity of the nervous system, before intentional and purposeful movements begin to emerge. Abnormalities in the quality, complexity, or variability of these movements may indicate early neurological dysfunction and are associated with a range of conditions, such as cerebral palsy and autism spectrum disorder [ 2 , 7 , 26 ] . Early identification of atypical motor patterns is particularly critical for preterm infants, who are at significantly higher risk of neurodevelopmental impairment and long-term disability [ 29 ] . The clinical assessment of infants’ spontaneous movements currently relies on the visual inspection of trained experts, who evaluate motor patterns through direct observation [ 9 ] . However, despite its strong predictive value, this approach is inherently subjective, time-consuming, and dependent on the individual clinician’s expertise, making it prone to inter-observer variability and limiting its scalability in routine clinical practice.
blocks.zh: 出生前婴儿(即怀孕37周前所生的新生儿)在产后住院期间表现出的自发、内生的运动模式,是早期评估神经发育轨迹的高度可靠的标志[8、11]。 在生命的头几个月里,婴儿表现出丰富的自发运动循环,这反映了神经系统的完整性,在有意和有目的的运动开始出现之前. 这些运动的质量,复杂性或可变性的异常可能表明早期神经功能失调,并会与一系列条件相联,如脑麻痹和自闭症谱系障碍[2,7,26]. 早期发现非典型运动模式对早产儿尤其关键,早产儿神经发育障碍和长期残疾的风险明显较高[29]. 目前,对婴儿自发运动的临床评估依赖于对受过训练的专家的目视检查,这些专家通过直接观察评估运动模式[9]. 然而,尽管这种方法具有很强的预测价值,但它本质上是主观的,耗时的,并且依赖于个体临床医生的专业知识,使其容易发生观察者之间的可变性并限制其在常规临床实践中的可扩展性.

blocks.en: In recent years, computer-assisted approaches based on markerless pose estimation (PE) and quantitative motion analysis from conventional 2D RGB video recordings have emerged as unobtrusive tools to support clinicians in this assessment. These approaches leverage PE outputs to derive quantitative motion descriptors from the reconstructed skeletal representation of the infant’s body, including joint angle trajectories, limb velocity profiles, movement complexity and variability measures, and symmetry indices between homologous body segments [ 30 , 27 , 25 ] . Current state-of-the-art PE models are trained on adult-centric datasets and therefore require adaptation to account for the unique anatomical proportions of infants and the diverse motor repertoires exhibited while lying in the supine position (i.e., the posture most commonly adopted during monitoring and routine care in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)) [ 14 , 3 , 35 , 6 ] . This requires the creation of manually annotated infants’ pose datasets. Annotation, however, remains a fundamental yet highly labor-intensive and time-consuming component of fully-supervised workflows which may be prone to errors [ 10 ] . In PE, human annotators provide ground-truth labels and frequently encounter ambiguous cases caused by occlusions, poor lighting, or motion blur, all of which can compromise annotation quality and, consequently, model reliability. This observation is supported by preliminary studies reporting annotation noise in widely used human PE datasets, highlighting the detrimental impact of noisy labels (i.e., keypoints annotated at incorrect anatomical locations) on PE model performance [ 28 ] . In generic PE applications, such annotation errors typically lead only to modest reductions in aggregate localization metrics (e.g., Average Precision (AP) or Percentage of Correct Keypoints (PCK)). In the infant movement-assessment setting that motivates this work, however, their impact is fundamentally different. A mislocalized keypoint introduces an artificial displacement into the reconstructed trajectory of the corresponding joint. Because clinical motion biomarkers are computed directly from these trajectories, such artifacts may impact the very signal that the system is intended to analyze [ 24 ] . Consequently, ensuring that annotations are not corrupted becomes a critical prerequisite for the downstream clinical validity of motion-based assessment pipelines.
blocks.zh: 近年来,基于无标记姿势(PE)的计算机辅助方法以及常规2D RGB视频录制的定量运动分析,已成为支持临床医生进行这一评估的无侵扰性工具. 这些方法利用PE产出,从婴儿身体的再生骨骼表现中得出定量运动描述符,包括联合角向轨迹、肢体速度剖面、运动复杂性和可变性测量,以及同位体各部分之间的对称指数[30、27、25]。 目前最先进的PE模型是针对以成人为中心的数据集进行培训的,因此需要进行调整,以考虑到婴儿独特的解剖比例以及处于苏平位置时表现出的多种多样的运动循环(即新生儿特别护理单位在监测和常规护理过程中最常用的姿态)[14、3、35、6]。 这需要建立人工注释的婴儿姿势数据集。 然而,注释仍然是全面监督的工作流程中一个基本而耗费大量劳动力和时间的部分,可能容易出错[10]。 在PE中,人的注释员提供地上真实的标签,并经常遇到被隔离、灯光差或运动模糊造成的模棱两可的情况,所有这些都会损害注释的质量,从而损害模型的可靠性。 这一观察得到初步研究的支持,这些研究报告了广泛使用的人类PE数据集中的注释噪声,突出了吵闹的标签(即在不正确的解剖位置上加注的关键点)对PE模型性能的不利影响[28]. 在一般的PE应用中,这种注释错误通常只会使总的本地化度量度略为减少(例如,平均精确度(AP)或正确关键点的百分比(PCK))。 然而,在鼓励这项工作的婴儿运动评估环境中,它们的影响是根本不同的。 地点错位的关键点将人为迁移引入相应关节的重建轨道。 由于临床运动生物标记是直接从这些轨迹计算出来的,这些文物可能会影响系统旨在分析[24]的信号本身. 因此,确保说明不腐败成为运动评估管道下游临床有效性的关键先决条件。

blocks.en: At the same time, learning with noisy labels became an established research area in deep learning, giving rise to a broad range of approaches, including specialized loss functions, noise-aware optimization strategies, and sample-selection methods [ 31 ] . Among the latter, many techniques are based on the small-loss hypothesis [ 13 , 34 ] , which assumes that samples incurring lower training losses during the early stages of optimization are more likely to be correctly labeled. These methods exploit the temporal evolution of the training loss, referred to as training dynamics, to distinguish clean from noisy annotations.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,用吵闹的标签来学习成为了深层学习中一个已确立的研究领域,从而产生了广泛的方法,包括专门的损失函数,噪音感知优化策略,以及样本选择方法[31]. 在后者中,许多技术是基于小损失假说[13,34],该假说假设在优化初期发生较低培训损失的样品更有可能被正确标注. 这些方法利用培训损失的时间演变,称为培训动态,以区分干净和吵闹的说明.

blocks.en: In a previous study [ 5 ] , we showed that sample-selection strategies based on the mean squared error (MSE) regression loss, conventionally used to train PE models, can effectively identify noisy keypoints. Specifically, we extracted per-keypoint features from the evolution of the regression loss during training and partitioned the entire set of annotated keypoints into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. The main limitation of that approach, however, is its relatively low precision. This stems from the fact that high and unstable regression loss can arise from two distinct sources: genuinely mislocalized (noisy) keypoints, and correctly annotated keypoints that are intrinsically hard to localize, for instance due to occlusion, motion blur, or ambiguous limb configurations. The resulting training dynamics of noisy and hard-to-learn keypoints become difficult to separate, causing a substantial fraction of correctly annotated but hard-to-learn keypoints to be misclassified as noisy and thereby limiting the reliability of the approach as a data-curation step prior to PE model training.
blocks.zh: 在之前的研究[5]中,我们显示,基于平均平方误差(MSE)回归损失的样本选择策略,通常用于训练PE模型,可以有效识别出吵闹的键点. 具体地说,我们从训练过程中回归损失的演变中提取出每个键点的特征,并通过不受监督的集群将整组有注释的键点分割成干净而吵闹的子集. 然而,这种做法的主要局限在于其准确性较低。 这是因为,高而不稳定的回归损失可能来自两个不同的来源:真正错位的(无声的)关键点,以及由于隔离、运动模糊或肢体配置模棱两可等原因而内在难以定位的正确附加说明的关键点。 由此产生的吵闹和难以学习的关键点的训练动态变得难以分离,导致大量有正确注释但难以学习的关键点被错误地归类为吵闹,从而限制了该方法作为PE模式培训前的数据校准步骤的可靠性.

blocks.en: The present work builds directly on this line of research and addresses its main limitation by encapsulating the task noisy-keypoint detection not in a regression framework, but in a classification one. First, the majority of effective training-dynamics-based noisy-label detection methods are developed for classification tasks. Second, and more specifically, an incorrectly localized keypoint induces a structural inconsistency between its spatial coordinates and the local visual evidence sampled at that location. We exploit this property by training a hybrid convolutional-attention classifier to predict the anatomical class of a keypoint (shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle) from its spatial coordinates and corresponding local visual features. We then extract training dynamics from the resulting cross-entropy (CE) classification loss and use them to construct per-keypoint feature representations, which are subsequently partitioned into clean and noisy subsets using an unsupervised clustering algorithm. These premises leads to our first research question: 1. RQ1: To what extent do per-keypoint CE-based training dynamics reflect label reliability in human pose estimation? We validate the proposed methodology on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of preterm infant videos acquired during routine clinical practice and currently among the largest datasets specifically focused on hospitalized preterm infants. Beyond assessing this advantage on the controlled, homogeneous NeoPose setting, it remains an open question whether it extends to substantially more heterogeneous PE benchmarks, such as COCO [ 20 ] , where increased visual and postural complexity may reduce the separability between clean and noisy dynamics, and where the practical utility of filtering as a data-curation step — measured not only by detection accuracy but by its downstream effect on pose estimation performance — has yet to be assessed. This leads to our second research question: 1. RQ2: Can the proposed noisy-label detection method generalize to heterogeneous PE datasets? The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 目前的工作直接建立在这一研究的基础之上,解决了其主要的局限性,将任务噪声-关键点检测封装在一个回归框架中,而不是在分类框架中。 首先,大多数有效的以训练为主的动态噪声标签检测方法是为分类任务而开发的. 第二,更具体地说,一个不正确的局部地键点导致其空间坐标与在该地所取样的当地视觉证据之间的结构不一致。 我们通过训练混合进取分类器来利用这个特性,从空间坐标和相应的局部视觉特征中预测一个关键点(肩、肘、腕、臀、膝和踝)的解剖等级。 然后,我们从由此产生的交叉交替(CE)分类损失中提取出训练动力学,并用它们构建出每个键点的特征表示法,然后使用无监督的集群算法将其分出为干净而吵闹的子集. 这些前提导致了我们的第一个研究问题: 1. RQ1:基于CE的每个关键点培训动态在多大程度上反映了人类姿势估计中的标签可靠性? 我们验证关于NeoPose的拟议方法。 NeoPose是新收集的在常规临床实践中获得的婴儿前期录像数据集,目前是专门针对住院婴儿的最大的数据集之一。 除了评估在受控、同质的NeoPose环境中的这一优势外,尚有疑问,即它是否扩大到更加多样化的PE基准,例如COCO[20],其中视觉和后部复杂性的增加会减少清洁和吵闹动态之间的可分性,而过滤作为一种数据查询步骤的实际效用——不仅通过检测的准确性,而且通过它对估计性能的下游影响来衡量——尚待评估。 这导致了我们第二个研究问题: 1. We introduce a hybrid convolutional-attention architecture that predicts the anatomical class and body side of a keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features, and derive a per-keypoint feature representation from its training dynamics for the unsupervised clustering of clean and noisy annotations. 2. We provide experimental validation under two realistic and clinically motivated noise scenarios (local positional perturbations and left-right semantic swaps) across increasing noise levels, demonstrating that CE-based training dynamics consistently outperform MSE-based training dynamics.. 3. blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work on learning with noisy labels. Section 3 presents the proposed methodology, including the keypoint classifier architecture and the clustering-based separation of clean and noisy keypoints. Section 4 describes the experimental protocol, including the noise injection procedures, the NeoPose dataset, the training settings, and the comparison methods. Section 5 presents and discusses the experimental results, organized around two research questions concerning the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed approach. Section 6 concludes the paper and outlines directions for future research.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Learning with noisy labels
blocks.zh: 2.1 使用吵闹的标签学习

blocks.en: It is by now widely recognized that deep neural networks and noisy labels form an uncomfortable pairing: the excess representational capacity of overparameterized architectures ultimately enables them to memorize incorrect annotations, causing a marked deterioration in generalization performance on held-out data [ 38 ] . Yet foundational research has demonstrated that this memorization process is not random [ 1 ] . In the early phases of optimization, networks exhibit a preference for extracting generalizable patterns from correctly labeled examples — a phenomenon commonly referred to as the memorization effect — before gradually fitting corrupted annotations as training continues. Leveraging this observation, the small-loss hypothesis [ 13 ] formalizes the intuition that samples incurring consistently low loss values during training are strong candidates for correct labeling, and has catalyzed a broad family of sample-selection methods that exploit either the loss distribution in early epochs or, more broadly, the full temporal evolution of the training loss, commonly referred to as training dynamics. Within this paradigm, several approaches have been proposed to extract discriminative features from loss trajectories. Co-teaching [ 13 ] consists in training two networks simultaneously, using each to select low-loss examples for the other in order to reduce the mutual influence of noisy samples. More recent methods exploit richer temporal signals: the First-time k-epoch Learning metric [ 37 ] estimates label reliability by measuring how many epochs a sample requires before being consistently classified correctly; ChronoSelect [ 33 ] employs a multi-stage temporal memory and trajectory analysis framework to segment data into clean, ambiguous, and noisy subsets; and an LSTM-based detector [ 15 ] processes raw training-dynamics sequences to automatically flag mislabeled instances without relying on hand-crafted features. Notably, these approaches have been developed almost exclusively for classification settings, and comparatively little work has addressed noisy-label learning under regression objectives [ 16 , 18 , 36 ] , where the loss landscape differs qualitatively and the small-loss hypothesis applies less directly. Restricting attention further to human pose estimation, the landscape is even more sparse. The work of Schwarz et al. [ 28 ] provides a systematic empirical analysis of how different categories of annotation noise affect the performance of PE models, defining an extended taxonomy of label errors and quantifying their impact on standard localization metrics. On the animal PE side, ScarceNet [ 19 ] integrates a threshold-driven, small-loss sample selection step as the initial stage of a semi-supervised pipeline designed to train on scarce and potentially noisy pseudo-labels. Most closely related to the present work is our previous study [ 5 ] , in which we showed that MSE regression loss-based training dynamics can effectively distinguish clean from noisy keypoints in the infant PE setting, by extracting per-keypoint features from the loss trajectory and partitioning the full annotation pool into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering.

blocks.en: Figure 1 depicts an overview of our proposed methodology, aimed at detecting noisy keypoints in the context of infant PE. The proposed framework takes as input a set of images and their associated keypoint annotations, and detects which keypoints are noisy and which are clean. The framework comprises two stages, as shown in Fig. 1 . In the first stage, a hybrid convolutional-attention classifier is trained to predict the anatomical category (shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle) of a keypoint from the input image and its spatial coordinates. In the second stage, keypoint-wise features extracted from the trained model are used as input to an unsupervised clustering algorithm, which separates clean annotations from noisy ones.

blocks.en: Let D D be a dataset of N N images, each containing a single infant lying in a supine position and annotated with a set of M M keypoints. Each keypoint is associated with 2D coordinates { ( x m , n , y m , n ) } m , n = 1 M , N \{(x_{m,n},y_{m,n})\}_{m,n=1}^{M,N} . We assume that a subset of these annotations across the entire dataset is noise-corrupted, meaning that the annotated 2D locations do not correspond to the true joint positions. We refer to these as noisy keypoints. Our approach builds on the sample selection paradigm and makes use of the well-established small-loss hypothesis. In our previous study [ 5 ] , we showed that MSE-based sample selection strategies can effectively distinguish between clean and noisy keypoints. Specifically, per-keypoint features are extracted from the training dynamics, and a clustering algorithm is applied to the entire pool of keypoints in the dataset to partition them into clean and noisy subsets. However, the main limitation of this approach is its relatively low precision.

blocks.en: Motivated by the observation that training-dynamics-based sample-selection methods in the noisy-label learning literature have been developed for classification tasks, we propose a novel framework for noisy-keypoint detection. The implementation of our proposed architecture is inspired by the work presented in [ 12 ] , where the authors introduce a method for estimating the 3D pose of two interacting hands from a single image, which decouples joint localization from joint identification. A key component of this framework—namely the module responsible for associating detected keypoints with their corresponding hand joints, which employs a self-attention mechanism operating on extracted CNN features—served as inspiration for the design of the proposed method. Specifically, we design a hybrid convolutional-attention keypoint classifier that, given a candidate keypoint location over the image and the image itself, predicts the anatomical class of the corresponding keypoint. Each keypoint is represented both by its spatial coordinates and by image features sampled at those locations. The CE loss is used to derive per-keypoint features, which are subsequently processed by a clustering algorithm. The key intuition is that incorrect keypoints correspond to erroneous spatial locations, which in turn yield misleading local visual features, creating a discrepancy between the input and its associated label that is reflected in the loss.

As the training progresses, for each keypoint m m in each image n n , the joint loss and side loss values are recorded at every epoch, forming two loss trajectory vectors, 𝐋 m , n joint ∈ ℝ E \mathbf{L}^{\text{joint}}_{m,n}\in\mathbb{R}^{E} and 𝐋 m , n side ∈ ℝ E \mathbf{L}^{\text{side}}_{m,n}\in\mathbb{R}^{E} , respectively, where E E is the number of training epochs. To reduce stochastic fluctuations, both trajectories are smoothed using a moving average filter. blocks.en: 4.1 Noise injection
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 喷出噪音

blocks.en: The work presented in [ 28 ] defines an extended error taxonomy of label noise in PE. Setting aside noise arising from annotated occluded keypoints and unannotated visible keypoints, in our experiments we consider two plausible noise scenarios: incorrect position and left–right swap. The first noise scenario is designed to reflect typical human inaccuracies during manual annotation, such as small shifts caused by mouse or touchpad imprecision. Following the work of Johnson et al. [ 17 ] , we model keypoint localization errors as an isotropic Gaussian distribution of vertical and horizontal displacements, i.e., by adding zero-mean Gaussian noise to the ground-truth joint locations, with variance ranging from 0.15% to 0.25% of the infant bounding box size. We refer to this as the random-noise scenario. The second noise scenario models structural confusion between the left and right parts of the body. This reflects the common ambiguity regarding whether “left” and “right” refer to the subject in the image or the annotator’s perspective. To simulate this type of noise, we randomly select a subset of samples from D D and swap left keypoints with right ones. We refer to this as the swapping-noise scenario. For both scenarios, we evaluate multiple configurations with progressively increasing levels of noise (from 10% to 40%), a range selected based on the most commonly used noise levels in the noisy-label classification literature (typically 20% and 40% for both instance-dependent and symmetric noise settings).

blocks.en: 4.2 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: In this study, we collect and curate a dataset of 65 RGB video recordings of 65 infants born preterm, who were recorded in a state of active wakefulness at term equivalent age or right before discharge in the neonatology department of the G. Salesi Hospital in Ancona, Italy. The 65 preterm infants in this dataset represent a comparatively robust sample, given how resource-intensive and logistically challenging clinical data collection is in this population. The dataset shows high variability in terms of gestational age ( 31.87 ± 3.77 31.87\pm 3.77 ), weight ( 2 ± 0.79 2\pm 0.79 kg), and length ( 44.13 ± 4.12 44.13\pm 4.12 cm). The infants were identified by clinicians among those in stable condition and capable of spontaneous movement. Videos are recorded using an Astra Mini S-Orbbec RGB-D camera, positioned approximately ∼ \sim 50 cm above the crib, with a spatial resolution of 640×480 pixels and a frame rate of 30 fps. Each video refers to a single infant, recorded shortly before hospital discharge. On average, approximately 116 frames per infant were randomly sampled from each continuous five-minute recording in order to maximize pose diversity, totalling 7563 RGB frames. Manual annotation was carried out by a team of experts neonatologists following the standard COCO keypoint annotation format.

blocks.en: 4.3 Training settings
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训环境

blocks.en: We use the backbone of EfficientNet-B3 as feature extractor, initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights. The model is optimized using the Adam optimizer for 40 epochs. The backbone is fine-tuned using a reduced learning rate of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , while all task-specific layers are optimized with a higher learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . Weight decay is set to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for all parameters. The learning rate schedule consists of a 10-epoch linear warm-up, followed by cosine decay down to a minimum learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Keypoint representations are learned in a 128-dimensional embedding space. Input coordinates are enriched using a sinusoidal positional encoding with 8 frequency bands and projected via an MLP into the shared embedding space. The attention module consists of a 2-layer cross-attention stack, with 2 attention heads per layer, enabling interaction between keypoint embeddings and global image features extracted from the backbone. The weight l ​ a ​ m ​ b ​ d ​ a lambda of the left/right classification loss is gradually increased during training up to 0.5, allowing the model to first focus on learning robust keypoint representations before incorporating directional information. Inputs are resized to 300 × 300 300\times 300 , and training is performed with a batch size of 16. Experiments are conducted using Python 3.11 and PyTorch 2.7.1 on a single NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPU (64 GB).

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.4 比较

blocks.en: We structure the experimental comparisons in two steps. First, we identify the most discriminative subset of CE-based per-keypoint features for the clustering stage. Second, using the best-performing feature configuration, we compare the proposed CE-based framework against our previously proposed MSE-based method on two datasets differing in visual complexity and population homogeneity: NeoPose and COCO.

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Comparison with the MSE-based method and cross-dataset evaluation on COCO
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 与基于MSE的方法和COCO跨数据集评价的比较

blocks.en: We compare the CE-based framework against our previously proposed MSE-based method, which follows the same sample-selection paradigm but derives training dynamics from the MSE regression loss of an HRNet model rather than from a classification loss. HRNet was selected as a widely adopted regression-based PE architecture, also commonly used in the infant PE literature [ 4 ] , and was trained from scratch using the MMPose toolbox under its default protocol. The resulting ( Δ ​ l \Delta l , Δ ​ t \Delta t ) descriptors are partitioned using the same K-means clustering procedure, isolating the effect of the loss type from the clustering stage itself. On NeoPose, both methods are evaluated under random and swapping noise across all injected noise levels. On COCO, given its higher heterogeneity, we restrict the comparison to the random-noise scenario, assessing both detection performance and the downstream effect of removing detected noisy keypoints on the localization accuracy of an HRNet model evaluated on a clean test set.

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ1: To what extent do per-keypoint CE-based training dynamics reflect label reliability in human PE?
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ1 : (中文(简体) ). 基于CE的按键培训动态在多大程度上反映了人类PE中的标签可靠性?

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports the F ​ 1 − s ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e F1-score s obtained by the MSE-based and CE-based detection pipelines across increasing levels of random and swapping noise on NeoPose. Across all configurations of the random-noise and swapping-noise scenario the CE-based approach substantially and consistently outperforms the MSE-based baseline.
This behavior may be due to the logarithmic penalization of misclassifications induced by the cross-entropy loss, in contrast to the quadratic penalization imposed by MSE [ 23 ] . In particular, MSE may suffer from gradient attenuation for small perturbations around the true keypoint location, resulting in less discriminative training dynamics. This is qualitatively confirmed in Fig. 2 , where the CE-based loss trajectories (second row) display markedly wider separation between the mean clean and noisy curves than their MSE-based counterparts (first row), and in Table 3 , where the proposed separability metric SeM is consistently lower (i.e., better separated) for the CE-based dynamics across randomic -noise levels.
A secondary observation concerns the comparatively high and stable performance observed under random noise even at elevated corruption levels. We interpret this as a consequence of the structural properties of NeoPose: because frames are sampled from continuous video recordings of infants lying in a constrained supine position, the dataset exhibits limited pose variability and strong spatial regularities among keypoints. As a result, small, localized coordinate perturbations —- the noise model adopted for the random-noise scenario – tend to remain within the same semantic neighborhood as the true keypoint, only marginally disrupting the visual-spatial consistency exploited by the classifier. This property does not extend to the swapping-noise scenario, since exchanging left and right labels alters the semantic structure of the supervision signal rather than introducing a local geometric perturbation. As the proportion of swapped keypoints grows, the model is exposed to increasingly conflicting supervision for symmetric body parts, and the problem becomes progressively more degenerate as left/right symmetry is approached (Fig. 3 ), explaining the steeper performance decay observed for swapping noise at higher corruption levels.

这种行为可能是由于对交叉交替损失所引发的错分类行为进行对数处罚,与MSE[23]规定的四重处罚形成对比. 特别是,在真正关键点位置周围的小扰动中,MSE可能会受到梯度减弱的影响,导致较少的歧视性培训动态。 这一点在图2中得到了质的证实,其中基于CE的损失轨迹(第二行)比基于MSE的对等曲线(第一行)显示出明显更广泛的平均清洁和吵动曲线的分离,而在表3中,对于基于CE的动态,在随机-噪音水平上,拟议的可分性指标SEM一直较低(即更好的分离)。

blocks.en: 5.3 RQ2: Can the proposed noisy-label detection method generalize to heterogeneous PE datasets?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ2:拟议中的噪声标签检测方法能否被概括到不同的PE数据集?

blocks.en:
To assess generalization beyond the relatively homogeneous and controlled NeoPose setting, we repeat the random-noise evaluation on a 14K-image subset of COCO [ 20 ] (Table 4 ). As expected, absolute detection performance decreases relative to NeoPose for both methods, which we attribute to the substantially higher visual and postural heterogeneity of COCO (i.e., multiple subjects, varied viewpoints, clothing, occlusion patterns, and backgrounds) compared to the structurally constrained infant-in-crib scenario. This is corroborated qualitatively by Fig. 4 , which shows visibly reduced separability between the mean loss trajectories of clean and noisy keypoints relative to NeoPose ( 2 ).
Despite this expected drop, three results support the robustness and value of the proposed approach. First, the CE-based pipeline consistently and substantially outperforms the MSE-based baseline across all tested noise levels, confirming on an independent, heterogeneous benchmark the same trend observed on NeoPose, and reinforcing the generality of the underlying hypothesis that classification-based training dynamics are more sensitive to keypoint-level label corruption than regression-based ones. Second, we observe a counter-intuitive trend whereby detection performance improves as the noise level increases, rather than degrading as one might expect. We hypothesize this reflects a class-balance effect intrinsic to unsupervised K-means clustering: because the algorithm receives no prior information about the relative size of the clean and noisy partitions, it is implicitly biased toward producing clusters of comparable size. At low noise levels, where clean keypoints vastly outnumber noisy ones, this bias works against correct partitioning; as the noise level increases and the two classes become more balanced, the clustering more closely matches the true underlying partition, improving F1-score. This suggests that future work could benefit from clustering or thresholding strategies that explicitly account for, or are invariant to, class imbalance.
Third, a per-keypoint breakdown (Fig. 5 ) reveals statistically significant heterogeneity in detection difficulty across anatomical landmarks (Friedman test, p<0.05). Post-hoc pairwise comparisons with FDR correction identify the left and right ankle as significantly harder to classify as clean/noisy than all other keypoints. This is consistent with established findings in the PE literature, which report that distal joints are disproportionately affected by localization ambiguity, motion blur, and occlusion [ 21 ] .

尽管这一预期下降,但有三项成果支持拟议办法的稳健性和价值。 首先,基于CE的管道在所有经过测试的噪声水平上一贯和大大地超过了基于MSE的基线,在一个独立、多样的基准上确认了在NeoPose上观察到的同样趋势,并强化了基于分类的培训动态比基于回归的假设对关键点级标签腐败更为敏感这一基本假设的普遍性。 第二,我们观察到一种反直觉的趋势,即随着噪音水平的增加,探测性能会得到改善,而不是像人们所期望的那样降低。 我们假设这反映了无监督的K-意思集群所固有的类平衡效应:由于算法没有事先收到关于干净而吵闹的分区的相对大小的信息,它隐含地偏向于产生可比较大小的集群. 在低噪声水平下,干净的键分数大大超过吵声分数,这种偏差不利于正确的分数;随着噪声水平的提高和两个分数的更相平衡,集群更紧密地匹配了真正的地底分数,改善了F1分数. 这表明,未来工作可以受益于明确说明或不利于阶级失衡的集群或门槛化战略。

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Downstream impact of noisy-label filtering on PE performance
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 噪声标签过滤对PE性能的下游影响

blocks.en: The results presented so far quantify the ability of the proposed CE-based framework to detect noisy keypoints, but do not directly establish whether removing these detected annotations is actually beneficial for training a downstream pose estimation model. To address this practical question, we train HRNet — the same regression-based PE architecture used to derive the MSE-based training dynamics in Section 4.4 — under each of the four COCO noise configurations (10%, 20%, 30%, 40% random noise), both (i) on the full, noise-corrupted training set, and (ii) on the corresponding training set after removing the keypoints flagged as noisy by the CE-based detection pipeline. Both models are evaluated on a held-out, clean COCO test set, using COCO AP. The results reveal a noise-level-dependent effect of filtering. At the lowest noise level (10%), training on the full, unfiltered training set yields a higher COCO AP (0.633) than training on the CE-filtered subset (0.601). Conversely, at 20%, 30%, and 40% noise, filtering consistently improves downstream performance relative to training on the unfiltered data, raising COCO AP from 0.544 to 0.618 at 20% noise, from 0.542 to 0.599 at 30% noise, and from 0.522 to 0.573 at 40% noise. This pattern is consistent with, and reinforces, the detection results already discussed: at 10% noise, the CE-based detector achieves its lowest noisy-label detection F ​ 1 − s ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e F1-score among the four configurations (Table 3), reflecting the class-imbalance bias of K-means discussed earlier — at low noise proportions, the clustering algorithm tends to produce more balanced (and therefore less precise) clusters, leading to a higher rate of false positives, i.e., correctly annotated keypoints erroneously discarded as noisy. In this regime, the loss of legitimately clean training signal outweighs the benefit of removing the comparatively few truly noisy keypoints, resulting in a net degradation of downstream performance. As the noise level increases to 20–40%, detection F ​ 1 − s ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e F1-score improves accordingly (Table 4 ), the clustering more closely approximates the true noisy/clean partition, and the benefit of removing an increasingly large and increasingly correctly identified set of corrupted annotations comes to dominate, translating into a measurable improvement in downstream PE accuracy. These findings provide an important practical caveat: noisy-label detection performance, on its own, is not a sufficient indicator of training utility — its downstream benefit also depends on the trade-off between detection precision and the proportion of valid training signal that any filtering procedure inevitably removes. They further suggest that the proposed framework is most beneficial as a data-curation step when annotation noise is moderate-to-high ( ≥ \geq 20% in our setting), while at very low noise levels a more conservative, precision-oriented filtering strategy may be preferable to avoid discarding informative clean annotations.
blocks.zh: 迄今提出的结果量化了拟议的基于CE的框架探测出吵闹的关键点的能力,但没有直接确定删除这些检测到的说明是否实际上有益于培训一种下游布局估计模型。 为了解决这一实际问题,我们根据四种COCO噪声配置(10%、20%、30%、40%的随机噪声),在(一) 完全由噪声破坏的训练装置上,以及在去除由CE探测管道所标出为噪声的关键点后,对HRNet进行相应的训练。 这两种模型都使用COCO AP在被搁置的清洁CO测试集中进行评估. 结果显示了滤取的噪音水平依赖效应. 在最低噪音水平(10%)下,在全套未过滤培训中的培训产生的COCO AP(0.633)高于CE过滤子集的培训(0.601)。 相反地,在20%、30%和40%的噪音中,过滤比未过滤数据的培训不断提高下游的性能,在20%的噪音中将COCO AP从0.544提高到0.618;在30%的噪音中从0.542提高到0.599;在40%的噪音中从0.522提高到0.573。 这种模式符合并强化了已经讨论过的检测结果:在10%的噪声下,CE基探测器在四种配置(表3)中实现了最低的噪声-标签检测F 1 - s c o r e F1分数,反映了前面讨论的K-指向的阶级-不平衡偏差——在低噪声比例下,集群算法倾向于产生更平衡(因此更精确)的集群,导致错误的正数率更高,即错误地被错误地丢弃为噪声的有注释的键. 在这个体制中,失去合法清洁的培训信号,比去除相对较少的真正吵闹的关键点的好处还要多,导致下游业绩的净退化。 随着噪音水平上升至20-40%,检测F 1 - s o c r e F1 - scount 相应改善(表4),集群更接近于真正吵闹/干净的分隔,清除越来越大且越来越正确识别出的一系列被腐蚀的记事的优点开始占据主导地位,转化为下游PE精度的可衡量改善. 这些调查结果提供了一个重要的实际告诫:高音标签检测性能本身不足以显示培训效用——其下游的好处还取决于检测精确度与任何过滤程序必然消除的有效培训信号的比例之间的取舍。 他们进一步提出,拟议框架作为数据校准步骤,在注释噪声中度至高度时最为有益(在我们的设定中为 \\ geq 20%),而在非常低的噪音水平上,更保守、更精确的过滤策略可能更可取,以避免丢弃信息性清洁说明。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Accurate infant PE models require large-scale supervised training, and training in turn requires manually annotated keypoints. Annotation, however, is an inherently error-prone process, and this limitation becomes especially critical in our clinical application: a noisy keypoint can distort the joint trajectories from which motion biomarkers are computed, undermining the reliability of the resulting clinical assessment. Motivated by this problem, in this work we introduce a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations, reformulating the task as an anatomical classification problem and exploiting cross-entropy training dynamics through a hybrid convolutional-attention architecture. This approach substantially improves upon a previously proposed MSE-based method, achieving higher F1-score in noisy-keypoints detection across both random-positional and left–right swap noise scenarios on NeoPose, and generalizing to the more heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering detected noisy keypoints also translates into measurable gains in downstream pose estimation accuracy. Despite these promising results, some limitations remain. The K-means clustering stage exhibits a class-balance bias that penalizes detection precision at low noise levels, and the noise scenarios considered, while clinically motivated, do not cover all sources of annotation error encountered in practice, such as those that can arise from occlusions or ambiguous poses. Future work will explore clustering strategies that are explicitly robust to class imbalance, extend the noise taxonomy to additional real-world annotation error types, and investigate integrating the proposed detection framework as an online data-curation step within the PE training loop, in order to improve the reliability of infant PE models used to support clinical motion assessment.
blocks.zh: 准确的婴儿教育模式需要大规模的监督培训,而培训则需要人工附加说明的要点。 然而,注释是一个内在的容易出错的过程,这种限制在我们临床应用中变得特别关键:一个吵闹的键点可以扭曲计算运动生物标记的联动轨迹,破坏由此而来的临床评估的可靠性. 受这个问题的驱使,我们在本作中引入了一个新的框架,用于探测吵闹的关键点说明,将任务重新定为解剖学分类问题,并通过混合进取式结构利用交叉进取式训练动态. 这种方法大大改进了先前提出的基于MSE的方法,在NeoPose的随机位置和左-右相交换噪声两种情景上,在高音键检测中达到F1分数,并概括到更加多样化的COCO基准,在COCO基准中,过滤检测到的噪音键也转化为下游的可衡量收益,从而形成估计准确性。 尽管取得了这些有希望的结果,但仍有一些局限性。 K-指集相阶段呈现出阶级平衡偏差,在低噪声水平上会惩罚检测精度,所考虑的噪声场景虽然具有临床动机,但并不包括实际中遇到的所有注释错误的来源,如可能由被隔离或模棱两可的姿势所引起. 未来工作将探索明确针对班级失衡的集聚战略,将噪声分类法扩展到额外的真实世界注释错误类型,并研究将拟议的检测框架作为PE培训圈内的在线数据查询步骤来整合,以提高用于支持临床运动评估的婴儿PE模型的可靠性.
